description: Every stand-in for a real capability in this repository, and how production keeps it out. kind: 'fixture' (deterministic test stand-in for a real provider or GPU capability; CPU stage and tests only), 'test_infrastructure' (stands in for cloud infrastructure in tests; never deployed), 'demo' (a real code path that charges nothing; allowed in production only in an explicitly labelled demo mode). The leakage gate (apps/api/tests/test_fixture_leakage.py, `pnpm verify --stage leakage`) fails when a stand-in is not registered here, a registered symbol is missing, or production accepts a setting that enables a fixture. A CPU fixture proves the workflow and integration contract, not the production quality or availability of the deferred capability.
